title: feature request: insulin calculator?
symptom: The user requests an integrated insulin calculator in xDrip where they can enter carbs and get a suggested dose based on their ratios, time, and current BG level.
fix: Enable Settings > xDrip Predictive Simulator Settings and Settings > xDrip+ Display Settings > Show Bolus Wizard Preview. The Bolus Wizard Preview will calculate a bolus suggestion when carbs are entered, considering I:C ratio, current BG, and BG momentum, but does not factor in exercise. It does not log entries automatically; the user must manually enter a treatment for the suggested dose.
evidence_quote:
Settings>xDrip Predictive Simulator Settings.
